TrustSquare is a global marketplace that opened on 1 September: coaches, clubs and instructors list what they offer, and people in their area find them by sport, by area and by level. A free account carries two listings — no card, no trial, no registration fee, and the free listings stay free.

It already knows who you are, so there is no form to hunt for. Two listings, free, no card.
Then: your club's TrustSquare page
Your club stays anonymous. People see the sport, the level, the area and the price — never your club's name, its address or anyone's phone number, until you accept an enquiry, and then only with the person who asked.
We earn only when someone asks to be put in touch: the person enquiring pays a small introduction fee (US$2), and your club decides whether to accept. The club pays nothing, keeps whatever it charges, and we never take a share of coaching or membership fees. Anything you mark as online is visible nationwide, not only in {{city_name}}.
